principle.en: Money moves through the product, so a regulator, a partner bank and a loss rate sit between the company and its revenue. The questions follow Qubit Capital's fintech due diligence checklist and Mercury's stage-based metrics: licence or agreement, cost of compliance, credit or fraud risk. They form the model's own block, weight 2.
principle.fr: De l'argent passe par le produit, donc un régulateur, une banque partenaire et un taux de perte se placent entre l'entreprise et son revenu. Les questions suivent la checklist de due diligence fintech de Qubit Capital et les métriques par stade de Mercury : licence ou agrément, coût de conformité, risque de crédit ou de fraude. Elles forment le bloc propre au modèle, poids 2.

sources.title: Qubit Capital, Fintech Due Diligence Checklist
Qubit Capital, How Do Fintech Founders Manage Capital
Mercury, Stage-based startup metrics that impact valuation

question.en: Which licence or agreement, held directly or through a partner, since when?
question.fr: Quelle licence ou quel agrément, détenu en direct ou via un partenaire, depuis quand ?

questions.found_if: The licence or the regulated partner named, the regulator, and the date obtained or the date applied for.
questions.note: A licence 'in progress' without a filing date = partial.

questions.found_if: A monthly or annual compliance cost (people, tools, audits) as a share of expenses.
questions.note: Benchmark shown next to the figure, never in the score.

question.en: Credit or fraud losses, and how they are measured?
question.fr: Pertes de crédit ou de fraude, et comment elles sont mesurées ?

questions.found_if: A loss rate or fraud rate over a period, with the denominator and the method.
questions.note: A 'low' loss rate without a figure = absent.

question.en: Which licence or agreement, held directly or through a partner, in which countries, since when?
question.fr: Quelle licence ou quel agrément, détenu en direct ou via un partenaire, dans quels pays, depuis quand ?

questions.found_if: The licence or the regulated partner named per country, the regulator, and the date obtained; the partner contract in the annexes.
questions.note: A licence 'in progress' without a filing date = partial.

question.en: What does compliance cost, confirmed against the P&L?
question.fr: Combien coûte la conformité, confirmé contre le P&L ?

questions.found_if: A monthly compliance cost (people, tools, audits) as a share of expenses, and the same lines in the P&L.
questions.note: Benchmark shown next to the figure, never in the score.

question.en: Credit or fraud losses over twelve months, and how they are measured?
question.fr: Pertes de crédit ou de fraude sur douze mois, et comment elles sont mesurées ?

questions.found_if: A loss rate or fraud rate over twelve months, by cohort, with the denominator and the method.
questions.note: A 'low' loss rate without a figure = absent.

name.fr: Licence, agrément ou correspondance avec le régulateur

requirement.en: The licence or agreement held, or the regulator's correspondence on the application, and the compliance cost lines of the P&L.
requirement.fr: La licence ou l'agrément détenu, ou la correspondance du régulateur sur la demande, et les lignes de coût de conformité du P&L.

requirement.en: Loan, transaction or policy book with losses, defaults, fraud and chargebacks, month by month.
requirement.fr: Livre des prêts, des transactions ou des polices avec les pertes, les défauts, la fraude et les rétrofacturations, mois par mois.

question.en: What does compliance cost, confirmed against the P&L and the audited accounts?
question.fr: Combien coûte la conformité, confirmé contre le P&L et les comptes audités ?

questions.found_if: A monthly compliance cost (people, tools, audits) as a share of expenses, and the same lines in the P&L and the audited accounts.

question.en: Credit or fraud risk: how is it underwritten and measured?
question.fr: Risque de crédit ou de fraude : comment est-il souscrit et mesuré ?

questions.found_if: The underwriting or fraud rules, the denominator and the method of the loss rate, and who bears the loss (the company, a partner, an insurer).
questions.note: A 'low' risk without a method = absent.

question.en: Losses on the book over 36 months, by cohort?
question.fr: Pertes sur le livre sur 36 mois, par cohorte ?

questions.found_if: Losses, defaults, fraud and chargebacks month by month over 36 months, by cohort, from the risk book.
questions.note: A single annual loss rate = partial.

question.en: Which licences or agreements, held directly or through a partner, in each country served, since when?
question.fr: Quelles licences ou quels agréments, détenus en direct ou via un partenaire, dans chaque pays servi, depuis quand ?

questions.found_if: The licence or the regulated partner named for each country in the P&L by geography, the regulator, and the date obtained; the licences or the partner contracts in the annexes.
questions.note: A country served without its licence or partner = partial.

question.en: What does compliance cost, confirmed against the P&L and three years of audited accounts?
question.fr: Combien coûte la conformité, confirmé contre le P&L et trois exercices audités ?

questions.found_if: A monthly compliance cost (people, tools, audits) as a share of expenses, and the same lines in the P&L and in each of the last three fiscal years of audited accounts.
questions.note: Benchmark shown next to the figure, never in the score.

question.en: Credit or fraud risk: how is it underwritten and measured?
question.fr: Risque de crédit ou de fraude : comment est-il souscrit et mesuré ?

questions.found_if: The underwriting or fraud rules, the denominator and the method of the loss rate, and who bears the loss (the company, a partner, an insurer).
questions.note: A 'low' risk without a method = absent.

question.en: Losses on the book over 48 months, by vintage?
question.fr: Pertes sur le livre sur 48 mois, par millésime ?

questions.found_if: Losses, defaults, fraud and chargebacks month by month over 48 months, by vintage, from the risk book.
questions.note: A single annual loss rate = partial. Older vintages worse than newer ones are a question for the call.
